mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_post_comment WHERE id = #{commentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_post_comment (post_id, author_user_id, parent_comment_id, content_status) VALUES (#{comment.postId}, #{comment.authorUserId}, #{comment.parentCommentId}, #{comment.contentStatus})
INSERT INTO s_post_comment_revision (comment_id, revision_no, body, moderation_status) VALUES (#{revision.commentId}, #{revision.revisionNo}, #{revision.body}, #{revision.moderationStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE s_post_comment SET current_revision_id = #{revisionId}, content_status = CASE WHEN public_revision_id IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' ELSE content_status END, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{commentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE s_post_comment SET public_revision_id = #{revisionId}, content_status = CASE WHEN content_status = 'HIDDEN' THEN 'HIDDEN' ELSE 'PUBLISHED' END, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{commentId} AND current_revision_id = #{revisionId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE s_post_comment_revision SET moderation_status = #{status} WHERE id = #{revisionId} AND moderation_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE s_post_comment SET content_status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{commentId} AND author_user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.author_user_id, c.parent_comment_id, r.id AS revisionId, CASE WHEN c.content_status = 'DELETED' THEN '评论已删除' ELSE r.body END AS body, c.content_status, c.created_at, u.nickname AS authorName, r.moderation_status AS moderationStatus FROM s_post_comment c JOIN s_post_comment_revision r ON r.id = CASE WHEN c.author_user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL THEN c.current_revision_id ELSE c.public_revision_id END JOIN s_post p ON p.id = c.post_id JOIN s_user_account u ON u.id = c.author_user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND p.content_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((c.author_user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.content_status != 'DELETED') OR (r.moderation_status = 'APPROVED' AND (c.content_status = 'PUBLISHED' OR (c.content_status = 'DELETED' AND c.parent_comment_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_post_comment child WHERE child.parent_comment_id = c.id AND child.content_status = 'PUBLISHED'))))) AND (c.parent_comment_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM s_post_comment parent JOIN s_user_account pu ON pu.id = parent.author_user_id WHERE parent.id = c.parent_comment_id AND parent.content_status IN ('PUBLISHED','DELETED') AND pu.status = 'ACTIVE' AND pu.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_user_block pb WHERE (pb.blocker_user_id = #{userId} AND pb.blocked_user_id = parent.author_user_id) OR (pb.blocker_user_id = parent.author_user_id AND pb.blocked_user_id = #{userId})))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_user_block b WHERE (b.blocker_user_id = #{userId} AND b.blocked_user_id = c.author_user_id) OR (b.blocker_user_id = c.author_user_id AND b.blocked_user_id = #{userId})) ORDER BY (c.author_user_id = #{userId} AND r.moderation_status != 'APPROVED') DESC, c.created_at, c.id LIMIT 200
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO s_post_like (post_id, user_id) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM s_post_like WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_post_like WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO s_user_block (blocker_user_id, blocked_user_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{blockedUserId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM s_user_block WHERE blocker_user_id = #{userId} AND blocked_user_id = #{blockedUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id,u.nickname,u.avatar_url FROM s_user_block b JOIN s_user_account u ON u.id = b.blocked_user_id WHERE b.blocker_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC,b.blocked_user_id
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_user_block WHERE (blocker_user_id = #{userId} AND blocked_user_id = #{otherUserId}) OR (blocker_user_id = #{otherUserId} AND blocked_user_id = #{userId}))

SELECT 'COMMENT' AS contentType, c.id AS reviewId, rev.id AS revisionId, rev.body, pub.body AS publicBody, c.content_status AS contentStatus, rev.moderation_status AS moderationStatus, rev.created_at AS submittedAt FROM s_post_comment c JOIN s_post_comment_revision rev ON rev.id = c.current_revision_id LEFT JOIN s_post_comment_revision pub ON pub.id = c.public_revision_id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND (rev.moderation_status = 'PENDING' OR c.content_status IN ('PUBLISHED','HIDDEN')) ORDER BY (rev.moderation_status = 'PENDING') DESC, rev.created_at, c.id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE s_post_comment SET content_status = #{status}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), deleted_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DELETED' THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE deleted_at END WHERE id = #{commentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE s_post SET comments_enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_post_recruitment r JOIN s_booking b ON b.id = r.booking_id WHERE r.post_id = #{postId} AND r.status IN ('RECRUITING','FULL') AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND b.start_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE s_post_recruitment_member m JOIN s_post_recruitment r ON r.id = m.recruitment_id JOIN s_post p ON p.id = r.post_id SET m.status = 'REMOVED', m.decided_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE p.author_type = 'USER' AND m.status IN ('APPLIED','APPROVED') AND ((p.author_id = #{userId} AND m.user_id = #{blockedUserId}) OR (p.author_id = #{blockedUserId} AND m.user_id = #{userId}))
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_post_comment WHERE id = #{commentId} AND author_user_id = #{userId})
